name: Nested encrypted archive extraction
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises extract_archive_step's recursion combined with password fallback: the attachment is an AES-256-encrypted 'secure_bundle.zip' (password 'outer2026') whose only member is itself an AES-256-encrypted 'confidential_inner.zip' (password 'inner2026') containing 'confidential_data.csv'. Both passwords are supplied to the same extract_archive_step and are retried at every recursion depth, so the outer layer opens with 'outer2026' (after an unencrypted attempt and 'inner2026' both fail) and the recursive call into confidential_inner.zip opens with 'inner2026' (after an unencrypted attempt and 'outer2026' both fail). Use with example-data/emails/nested_encrypted_zip.eml.
